task: I want a report (the folder must be written in the appropriate path/location) about the problems that can occur in the UI/UX or in the mandatory subscription process itself. Examine the flow itself carefully, discover potential problems, and write a report.

findings.title: E6 factual error: claims no UNIQUE constraint on channel_id, but one exists
findings.detail: Report states 'there is no UNIQUE constraint on channel_id in the channels table' but migration _V3 (app/db/migrations.py:119) defines 'channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE'. The entire E6 issue is invalid and must be removed or corrected.

findings.title: Missing finding: gate screen text and keyboard use different icon sets
findings.detail: Gate screen text uses 👤 (channel) / 🔰 (group) icons while gate keyboard buttons use 📢 (channel) / 👥 (group). Users see mismatched icons on the same screen. Should be added as a new finding.
